2026_05_BAL_ATL.headline: Baltimore’s quarterback uncertainty meets Atlanta’s surging ground game
2026_05_BAL_ATL.paragraph1: Atlanta has built momentum behind Bijan Robinson’s explosive rushing, creating a difficult assignment for a Baltimore defense that must prevent long early-down gains. The Ravens can answer through Derrick Henry, but Lamar Jackson’s ankle injury makes the passing-game balance uncertain if Tyler Huntley starts. Atlanta’s Michael Penix Jr. has recently directed an efficient attack, so Baltimore cannot afford to let the Falcons control possession. The decisive question is whether the Ravens can force longer passing situations without sacrificing their own rushing threat.
2026_05_BAL_ATL.model_rationale: Atlanta’s rushing efficiency can dictate defensive spacing, while Baltimore needs its own ground game to preserve manageable downs and avoid placing too much burden on uncertain quarterback availability.
